articles.title: The four restrictions Tom Brady faces from the NFL that 'hurt' his contract with FOX
articles.standfirst: Brady’s dual roles as a FOX analyst and Raiders minority owner come with rules
articles.summary: Brady’s dual roles as a FOX analyst and Raiders minority owner come with rules
articles.body:
Tom Brady’s transition from NFL superstar to television analyst has brought him a lucrative second career, but his broadcasting responsibilities are complicated by his ownership stake in the Las Vegas Raiders.

The seven-time Super Bowl champion signed a 10-year, $375 million contract with FOX, earning approximately $37.5 million annually. He also became a minority owner of the Raiders after NFL team owners approved the deal in October 2024.

However, combining these positions means Brady must follow strict league rules governing his access, commentary and potential return to playing.

His first season in the broadcast booth wasn’t easy. Brady initially struggled with excessive preparation and relying too heavily on notes.

Over time, he refined his approach, focusing more on analysing matchups and anticipating plays. FOX’s NFL broadcasts averaged 18.7 million viewers during the 2025-26 season, representing a six percent increase.

The four NFL restrictions affecting Brady’s broadcasting role

The NFL introduced safeguards to address potential conflicts of interest arising from Brady’s dual roles. While some restrictions have been adjusted, the rules continue to influence his work as FOX’s lead analyst.

One major limitation concerns access to team facilities. Brady faces restrictions on visiting NFL facilities, observing practices and gathering information directly from players and coaches.

This can make preparing for broadcasts more challenging, particularly when team insights could strengthen his analysis.

His participation in production meetings has also been restricted. Brady was initially prohibited from attending these sessions both in person and virtually, limiting his opportunities to hear directly from coaches ahead of games.

The NFL subsequently relaxed some rules, allowing him to participate remotely, although his access remains different from that of other broadcasters.

Another significant challenge involves public criticism of officials and rival teams. League rules restrict Brady from making certain public comments about referees and other clubs.

Viewers often expect a former quarterback of his experience to offer opinions on controversial decisions and opposing teams, making this limitation particularly relevant to his broadcasting role.

The final restriction concerns a potential return to the field. Brady can’t resume playing in the NFL while retaining his ownership interest in the Raiders.

In an interview with CNBC, he acknowledged asking the league about a possible comeback, although he said officials weren’t enthusiastic about the idea. The NFL also raised potential salary-cap complications involving an active player who owns part of a franchise.

Brady subsequently reiterated that he was happy in retirement, despite enjoying the opportunity to play in a flag football event.

"I actually have inquired, and they don't like that idea very much," said Brady . "So I'm going to leave it at that.

"We explored a lot of different things, and I'm very happily retired. Let me just say that, too."

FOX pays Brady for his football knowledge and distinctive perspective, but league regulations limit some of the access and commentary that could enhance his coverage.

However, improved performances in the booth and rising viewership suggest the partnership continues to deliver value.

articles.title: Who is Candice Swanepoel, the 38-year-old Victoria's Secret supermodel rumored to be dating Tom Brady?
articles.standfirst: The South African model has built an international fashion career, raised two children and established her own business
articles.summary: The South African model has built an international fashion career, raised two children and established her own business
articles.body:
C andice Swanepoel is attracting fresh attention after a report claimed she has been dating former NFL star Tom Brady .

According to Us Weekly, a source said the pair had been together “for a while,” although neither Swanepoel nor Brady has publicly confirmed the alleged relationship.

The reported romance has sparked interest in Swanepoel , who is one of Victoria's Secret's best-known models and has spent nearly two decades working in the fashion industry.

While Brady became famous through his record-setting American football career, Swanepoel built her own reputation on international runways and magazine covers.

Born and raised in Mooi River, a small town in South Africa, Swanepoel was discovered by a talent scout when she was just 15.

According to her official website, she began securing modelling work across Europe the following year before eventually moving to New York to pursue her career full-time.

Her career quickly developed, bringing opportunities to work with major fashion publications and luxury designers.

She became particularly associated with Victoria's Secret after joining the brand in 2007, later earning Angel status and becoming a regular presence at its fashion shows.

How Candice Swanepoel became a Victoria's Secret star

Swanepoel's relationship with Victoria's Secret has been a defining part of her professional life.

She has appeared in the brand's campaigns and runway shows alongside some of the industry's most recognisable models, helping establish her as an international fashion figure.

She also appeared in the brand's famous Fantasy Bra campaign in 2013, wearing a heavily jewelled design that attracted considerable attention.

Her work has extended beyond lingerie, with editorial appearances and campaigns across the wider fashion and beauty industries.

More recently, Swanepoel returned to the Victoria's Secret runway for the 2026 fashion show in Los Angeles. Her continued involvement with the brand demonstrates the longevity of a career that began when she was a teenager.

Away from modelling, Swanepoel has developed her own business interests, including Tropic of C, a swimwear label. The venture has given her another role in fashion, allowing her to work on a brand beyond her modelling assignments.

Her personal life has also included a long-term relationship with Brazilian model Hermann Nicoli . The pair met when Swanepoel was 17, became engaged in 2015 and eventually separated in 2018.

They share two sons, Anacã and Ariel, and Swanepoel has spoken about the importance of balancing motherhood with her professional ambitions.

The dating reports have also drawn comparisons with Brady's previous marriage to fellow supermodel Gisele Bündchen .

The former couple married in 2009 and divorced in 2022. They share two children, Benjamin and Vivian , while Brady also has a son, Jack, with actress Bridget Moynahan .

Since his divorce, Brady has been linked in media reports to several high-profile women, including model Irina Shayk and social media personality Alix Earle .

In January 2026, he told People: “You know what? I don't have much time for a personal life or much time for myself, but I love working and I love my kids.”

For now, the connection between Brady and Swanepoel remains a reported romance rather than a publicly confirmed relationship.

Neither has commented on the claim, leaving details about when they may have started seeing each other unclear. Until either speaks publicly, the story remains based on an unnamed source rather than confirmation from the two stars.
